name: the notice board of a candidate registration office seen flat from the front: a pale blue striped wall with a window and a wall clock high on it, a long felt notice board in a wooden frame with pinned papers (a sheet of the election law, an ID card, two diplomas), a long wooden desk under it where folders pile up, and an upright white ballot box at the desk's left end
fits: anything about the paperwork of an election or a registration: the requirements to become a candidate, which documents count, an age limit on an ID card; the hero is the paper pinned in the middle of the board, the camera pans from one pinned paper to the next
recipe: flat 2D front view (no iso), one scale of 23.57 px a cm (an A4 sheet is 700 x 495 px): a wall rect with stripes that bleeds past the frame, a taupe framed board with a grey felt face, white sheets with grey text bars and two pins each, diplomas with a border, an emblem, a photo, a seal and a signature line, a small ID card with its photo on the right, a desk slab with panels, folders as flat grey slabs seen from the edge, a white ballot box with a dark slot, a clear window and a hanging seal; no meaning colours in the dressing (yellow only on the tick, the equals sign, the highlighter and the FAKTA stamp)
